questions.prompt: What is the purpose of follow-up?
questions.answer: Fulfil commitments, clarify agreed matters or maintain mutually wanted contact.

questions.prompt: Does every contact need a fixed follow-up schedule?
questions.answer: No; timing depends on purpose, agreement and preference.

questions.prompt: What should happen after a refusal?
What is a useful success criterion?
questions.answer: Accurate, proportionate fulfilment of actual commitments and respect for choice.
questions.feedback: Do not grade reply rates as personal worth.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Designs reliable, proportionate follow-up that fulfils agreements, respects refusal and minimises information collection.
scoring.transfer: Complete an ethical networking plan with a reciprocal network map, bounded requests, consent-based introduction and follow-up log. Include an unanswered request, refusal, fulfilled commitment, privacy boundary and revised plan after feedback. Use fictional information only.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
